employee-updates-current-row-contract.text: Read contract: EmployeeRepository.GetByIdAsync LEFT JOINs employment_details filtered by end_date IS NULL (current open row) and departments; employees without an open job return HasEmploymentDetails=false. UpdateAsync detail statement only touches the open row; zero matches = no-op.

create-smart-routing.text: UI contract: EmployeeCreateViewModel.IncludeEmploymentDetails drives Create POST routing to CreateAsync vs CreateWithDetailsAsync; detail-only validation lives in IValidatableObject so base employees bypass it. View models use DateOnly + DateRangeInPast.

deferred-double-decimal.text: Task deferred: double->decimal refactor for Oracle NUMBER ids across models/repos/controllers; pre-dated all current feature code by design.

employee-soft-delete-contract.text: Delete contract: soft delete writes employees.is_deleted=1 (rows hidden by is_deleted=0 filter in GetAll/GetById); DeleteWithDetailsAsync purges employment_details then department_managers then employees in one transaction; HasDependenciesAsync sums both child counts in one scalar query. View shows destructive button only when dependencies exist, gated by checkbox + native confirm.

lookup-db-driven-contract.text: Lookup contract: all dropdown ids/titles come from ILookupRepository (genders, employment_types, employment_status read as LookupItem(Id,Title)); enum positions ( Gender/EmploymentType/Status enums) must never be assumed in UI binding. Present-date-only validations: Range(1, decimal.MaxValue) for presence + conditional IValidatableObject checks.

db-rebuild-identity-reset.text: Verified fact: dropping Oracle tables drops their identity sequences, so ids restart at 1 per rebuild via db/ scripts. Lookup ids are therefore never hard-coded; all UI ids come from ILookupRepository reads.

constraint-name-mapping.text: Exception mapping rule: typed ConstraintException carries schema constraint name (uq_det_current_job etc); OracleExceptionHandler matches ORA message by it. Function-based indexes print SYS_NC synthetic columns, so field-name text matching fails. Unmapped OracleException becomes DatabaseAccessException with generic message; controllers never render ex.Message for non-typed exceptions (UserMessages.GenericFailure).

step8-tx-ownership.text: sp_assign_manager (db/05_procedures.sql) holds no COMMIT; the .NET caller owns commit/rollback - AssignWithStoredProcedureAsync wraps the proc call in an explicit transaction, AssignWithNetTransactionAsync covers dated backfills. Contracts renamed per spec: IEmploymentRepository / IDepartmentManagerRepository. Multi-statement flows use: await using var tx = await connection.BeginTransactionAsync(); commands bound via Transaction = (OracleTransaction)tx; helper DbConnectionExtensions bridges IDbConnection (factory return) to the async API. Employment create gates replacements on GetCurrentAsync (new start must be after current start) before CreateReplacingCurrentAsync; close view models are employee/department-scoped (EndCurrentAsync), no row-id closes.

statistics-dashboard-design.text: Dashboard stats derive from closed rows, not snapshots: month-end headcount/payroll = employment_details rows with start_date <= month AND NVL(end_date, month) >= month; flows bucket by TRUNC(start_date/end_date,'MM'). Trend window 24 months; soft-deleted employees drop out retroactively (user approved). Watchlists: Probation older than 90 days, On Leave/Notice Period open rows, departments with no open department_managers row. SQL is sysdate-relative; no new db scripts needed.

dashboard-chart-pipeline.text: Dashboard chart data flows C# -> @Html.Raw(System.Text.Json JSON island #dashboard-data, Web defaults camelCase, angle brackets escaped) -> wwwroot/js/dashboard.js builds Chart.js canvases from wwwroot/lib/chart/chart.umd.min.js (local v4.4.9 copy, no CDN). Charts animation:false under prefers-reduced-motion. Dashboard failure path: per-section try in controller; trend failure = DataReady=false renders banner, no redirect loop.

positions-schema-addition.text: positions is master data (unique title) referenced by employment_details.position_id; free-text job_title dropped entirely (user decision). Rebuild scripts 01_schema/04_seed carry the canonical shape; 06_positions.sql is the guarded migration for populated installs, written with every statement /-terminated and dynamic SQL inside guards because PL/SQL compilers resolve referenced columns at compile time. employment ids in live DB range in the 20s-30s: never guess identity ids in HTTP tests, read dropdown option values from the page.

leave-domain-rules.text: Leave domain (db/01_schema.sql, 07_leave.sql): uq_lr_open_request is a function-based unique index binding leave_statuses.id = 1 to Pending, so Pending must be the first row inserted into leave_statuses and the seed raises -20001 if it is not id 1. leave_requests allows end_date = start_date (single-day). leave_balances.used_days moves only in two places: ApproveAsync adds inclusive calendar days (same transaction as the status flip; a 0-row balance update rolls back with InsufficientLeaveBalanceException), CancelAsync subtracts them for an Approved request only. Controllers resolve Pending/Approved/Rejected/Cancelled ids from ILookupRepository by title, never literals. chk_bal_used (0 <= used <= entitlement) is the safety net; the app pre-checks entitlement so the user sees days remaining.

employee-purge-includes-leave.text: DeleteWithDetailsAsync in EmployeeRepository purges employment_details, department_managers, leave_requests then leave_balances inside one transaction before deleting the employee; without the leave deletes FK_LR_EMPLOYEE/FK_BAL_EMPLOYEE fail the destructive path with ORA-02292. HasDependenciesAsync still counts only employment_details + department_managers on purpose: an employee with only leave history soft-deletes (is_deleted = 1) and keeps that history.

leave-ui-scope.text: TASK-12 UI: leave.css (register-book direction from design.yaml intent.style) is loaded per view through the Styles section, not from _Layout, so only Leave screens and the Dashboard absence strip pick up its tokens. design.yaml is the project's first design system file.

oracle-constraint-handler-throws-typed.text: OracleExceptionHandler.HandleConstraintExceptions used to throw constraint.FieldException, which every typed ConstraintException sets to its inner OracleException. That made every controller catch (ConstraintException) dead code and let raw ORA text reach the web layer. TASK-13 changed it to throw constraint (the typed exception); FieldException stays as the inner OracleException. Verified live: duplicate department name now renders the friendly Name error with no ORA text. Any new constraint mapping relies on this throw.

department-hierarchy-contract.text: Department hierarchy: departments.parent_department_id is a nullable self-FK (fk_dept_parent); chk_dept_parent_not_self blocks parent=id and db/08_department_hierarchy.sql adds both to populated DBs. Depth is not constrained by Oracle, so DepartmentController.Update rejects self and descendants: WouldCreateCycleAsync walks ancestors with START WITH parent CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR parent_department_id = id. GetParentCandidatesAsync(excludeId) walks the excluded department's subtree, so the update dropdown can never offer a cycle. GetHierarchyAsync returns depth-first DepartmentNode rows (dept_tree sort_path) with direct headcount (open employment_details rows on non-deleted employees) and rollup (COUNT DISTINCT employee_id across the subtree). Deleting a department with reports is blocked by the FK (ChildFoundException), no cascade.
